mentions.heading: Our results of operations could be affected by natural events in the locations in which we operate.
mentions.detail: Principal manufacturing and design sites exposed to severe weather, geological events, epidemics; climate change may intensify
mentions.quote: Climate change might exacerbate these occurrences or cause natural disasters to occur with greater frequency and with more intense effects.

mentions.heading: Rapid technological change in markets we serve requires us to develop new technologies and products.
mentions.detail: Shortened product life cycles and ASP declines; R&D investments made before commercial viability assured
mentions.quote: In some cases, we might not realize a return or the expected return on our investments because they are generally made before commercial viability can be assured.

mentions.heading: We face supply chain and manufacturing risks.
mentions.detail: Supplier disruptions from quality excursions, conflict-free mineral access, credit market stress affecting supplier liquidity
mentions.quote: If our suppliers are unable to access credit markets and other sources of needed liquidity, we may be unable to obtain needed supplies, collect accounts receivable or access needed technology.

mentions.heading: We face supply chain and manufacturing risks.
mentions.detail: Key semiconductor materials sourced from limited geographies; geopolitical tensions and export controls on minerals, equipment raise cost and lead times
mentions.quote: Further, certain key materials used in semiconductor manufacturing are primarily sourced from limited geographies. Governments have adopted or proposed measures, including export controls on certain minerals, materials and equipment, that could adversely affect equipment and material availability, cost or movement.

mentions.heading: We face supply chain and manufacturing risks.
mentions.detail: Subcontracted wafer fab, assembly/test, advanced logic process development and facility construction; limited alternates, no long-term contracts
mentions.quote: We do not have long-term contracts with all of these suppliers, and the number of alternate suppliers is limited.

mentions.heading: We face supply chain and manufacturing risks.
mentions.detail: Ongoing manufacturing capacity investments under capital management strategy may not earn expected returns
mentions.quote: We have made and will continue to make investments in manufacturing capacity consistent with our capital management strategy, and we might not realize our expected return on those investments.
